description: A CTO is selecting a cloud provider for a new SaaS product. They need to analyze cost-efficiency, regional availability, and specific AI/ML service offerings.

user_profile.context: Pre-launch phase, making foundational tech decisions

fact_sheet.fact: The 'CogniStream' SaaS product requires GPU-accelerated instances for its core video transcoding module.
The projected peak data egress for 'CogniStream' is 15 TB per month for the first year of operation.
The 'CogniStream' platform must maintain GDPR compliance for its planned launch in the European Union market.
The primary relational database for 'CogniStream' must be a managed service supporting PostgreSQL version 15 or higher.
The internal project for cloud provider selection at Vortex Innovations Inc. is codenamed 'Project Stratus'.
Dr. Aris Thorne, CTO, is the final decision-maker for Project Stratus.
The final comparative analysis report for all three cloud providers is due on November 8, 2024.
AetherGrid offers a 3-year reserved instance discount of 42% on its 'AG-Compute-G4' instances.
Data egress from AetherGrid's 'us-east-1' region is priced at $0.09 per GB for the first 10 TB/month.
The AetherGrid 'AG-Compute-G4' instance type provides 8 vCPUs and 32 GB of RAM.
AetherGrid's AI service, 'Synapse Vision,' costs $1.50 per 1,000 image recognition API calls.
AetherGrid currently operates data centers in three regions: 'us-east-1', 'eu-west-2', and 'ap-southeast-1'.
QuantumLeap Cloud's 'QL-GPU-P4' instance, equipped with a single NVIDIA A100 equivalent, costs $0.75 per hour on-demand.
QuantumLeap Cloud offers a 1-year committed use discount of 25% on compute resources, billed monthly.
QuantumLeap Cloud's measured cross-region network latency between 'us-central1' and 'europe-west4' averages 78ms.
The 'QL-Sphere-DB' managed PostgreSQL service from QuantumLeap Cloud guarantees a 99.99% uptime SLA.
QuantumLeap's 'NexusML' platform allows custom model training using pre-configured Docker containers with TensorFlow and PyTorch.
Training a model on QuantumLeap's 'NexusML' with a 'p4.large' configuration costs $2.20 per hour.
QuantumLeap Cloud does not currently operate any data centers on the African continent.
QuantumLeap's 'europe-west4' region, located in the Netherlands, is fully GDPR and ISO 27018 compliant.
Stellaris Services provides 500 GB of free object storage per month with their 'Stellaris-Vault' service.
Data egress from Stellaris Services is a flat rate of $0.05 per GB globally, after the first 1 TB per month.
Stellaris's 'SS-Compute-M6' instance offers 16 vCPUs and 64 GB of RAM, optimized for memory-intensive applications.
The NVMe SSD storage attached to 'SS-Compute-M6' instances provides up to 125,000 sustained IOPS.
Stellaris Services' 'Cognition Suite' offers a neural text-to-speech service supporting 25 languages and 5 voice styles.
The 'Cognition Suite' text-to-speech service is priced at $4.00 per 1 million characters processed.
Stellaris Services operates a data center in 'sa-east-1' (São Paulo) to serve the South American market.
Stellaris Services is certified for SOC 2 Type II compliance across all 12 of its global regions.
A technical proof-of-concept with QuantumLeap Cloud is scheduled for October 22-25, 2024, focusing on ML model performance.
The 'CogniStream' user authentication module must integrate with a managed identity service that natively supports the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
AetherGrid's 'Synapse' platform includes a managed data labeling service at a cost of $0.08 per labeled image with bounding boxes.
QuantumLeap Cloud's 'Enterprise Tier' support plan costs $12,000 per month and provides a 15-minute response time for critical issues.
